newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen B shares close down in dull trade.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen B shares close down in dull trade.

text.p: Shenzhen's B share index closed down on Thursday in dull trade, with investors staying out of the market ahead of the National Day holiday, analysts said.
The B share index fell 0.35 points, or 0.39 percent, to 89.36, with turnover down to HK$10.26 million from HK$20.79 million on Wednesday.
China's National Day holiday will last for five days from September 28 to October 2. Trading in Shenzhen will resume on October 3.
The fall in the B shares was a result of profit-taking after rises in three consecutive sessions, analysts said.
With domestic investors banned from buying new B shares, trading will remain sluggish for some time, one analyst said.
Conglomerate Zhonghao was the biggest loser and fell HK$0.19, or 10.92 percent, to HK$1.55. Property concern Vanke fell HK$0.49, or 10.89 percent, to HK$4.01.

Shenzhen Petrochemical slipped HK$0.18 to HK$2.30 and television maker Huafa fell HK$0.10 to HK$1.60. Shenzhen International Enterprise, which is involved in the real estate and retail sectors, dropped HK$0.06 to HK$2.62.
Trading was mainly focused on large-cap issues, analysts said.
Refrigerator maker Meilin held steady at HK$3.29 on the session's heaviest trade of 338,800 shares. Guangdong Power was unchanged at HK$5.39, with 329,300 shares traded.
Shenzhen Properties bucked the trend with a rise of HK$0.16, or 6.56 percent, to HK$2.60 on thin trade of 58,132 shares.
The class A market had a technical rebound on Thursday, up 3.68 points, or 1.35 percent, to 275.58, brokers said.
Turnover hit 4.15 billion yuan compared with Wednesday's 4.60 billion yuan and the composite index put on 3.20 points, or 1.24 percent, to 260.30.

Xian Tourist Services (Group) Co Ltd, which listed 21.60 million class A shares in Shenzhen on Thursday, ended the session at 8.70 yuan on trade of 6.82 million shares, compared with an offer price of 3.80 yuan.

Jiaozuo Wanfang Aluminum Manufacturing Co Ltd, whose 32.01 million A shares were listed in Shenzhen on Thursday, ended the day at 11.28 yuan on trading of 7.84 million shares. The shares were issued at 6.80 yuan per share earlier this month.
